run_layout.note: run.sh and env.txt are written before the run starts, so a run that crashes is still reproducible from what is on disk.

data_access.obtainable_by_receiver: the synthetic corpus downloads from its public identifier with the command in HANDOVER.md; no account or shared drive is needed

tasks.goal: Reproduce the reported development-split number before changing anything.
tasks.expected_output: logs/train.log ends with 'dev_score=0.7315' and results/metrics.json records the same value
tasks.done_when: results/metrics.json exists and its dev_score is within the recorded noise floor of 0.7315

tasks.goal: Read the error by slice and report which slice carries most of the loss.
tasks.expected_output: results/slices.csv with one row per slice, each carrying its own count
tasks.done_when: every slice in results/slices.csv has a count, and the counts sum to the evaluation set size printed by the script

do_not_change: the locked test split under data/locked-test/

rehearsal.performed_by: a group member who had not seen the project
rehearsal.outcome: T1 reproduced dev_score=0.7315 on the second attempt; the first failed because HANDOVER.md did not say the data download must finish before run.sh, which has since been added
rehearsal.took: about two hours including the download
